name: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp

lifecycle.note: Weights are still public on DeepSeek's Hugging Face organisation under the MIT License. In the DeepSeek API it was replaced by DeepSeek-V3.2 on 2025-12-01.

replacedBy.note: In the DeepSeek API only: both API model names were upgraded to DeepSeek-V3.2, which DeepSeek calls the official successor to V3.2-Exp. The weights stay available.

relations.note: Continued pre-training from a DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus base checkpoint (context extended to 128K) to add DeepSeek Sparse Attention, followed by post-training.

summary.text: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp is an experimental language model in DeepSeek's V line, released on 29 September 2025 in the app, web chat and API, with open weights under the MIT License. It adds DeepSeek Sparse Attention to DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus, and DeepSeek describes it as an intermediate step toward its next-generation architecture.

changes.text: Adds DeepSeek Sparse Attention, a fine-grained sparse attention mechanism with a lightning indexer; DeepSeek says this is the only architectural change.
DeepSeek says sparse attention makes long-context training and inference more efficient; it cut API prices by more than 50 percent with this release.

features.note: Thinking and non-thinking modes, served as deepseek-reasoner and deepseek-chat.

openWeights.note: MIT License for the repository and the weights.

variants.name: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Base
variants.note: Base weights after continued pre-training; the DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp model card names it as its base model.

notes: DeepSeek calls it an experimental model and an intermediate step toward its next-generation architecture. The tech report gives 128K as the context length of the V3.1-Terminus base checkpoint it started from but does not state the context window or parameter count of V3.2-Exp itself, so both are left out. The Hugging Face repository for the base weights was created on 2025-09-29, which no DeepSeek page states in text.
